idea-plugin.name: Ansible
idea-plugin.description:
Write Ansible playbooks and roles with completion for playbook fields, role fields, and role names. Completion and offline Quick Documentation are available for bundled modules and their options.

To report bugs and feature requests you can create a GitHub issue. For code contribution you can create pull requests.
Any type of contribution is highly appreciated.

You can support this plugin by starring the GitHub repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0

  • Require an IntelliJ Platform 2026.2 or newer IDE. Building from source requires JDK 25.
  • Support fully qualified module names in completion and Quick Documentation while retaining short names.
  • Bundle Ansible 15.0.0 module documentation. The generator preserves nested options, return values, and examples, and shares documentation between aliases.
  • Fix errors when opening empty YAML files or resolving role names with special characters.
  • Enable plugin error and UI freeze reporting through JetBrains Marketplace.

1.0.0

  • Fix compatibility issues with 2024.3+ IDEs
  • Fix NPE on rare cases
  • Upgrade Intellij platform plugin to version 2
  • Upgrade plugin Java version to 21
You can support the plugin by starring the GitHub repository.
